items.title: McKesson’s (NYSE:MCK) Q3 CY2026 adjusted EPS top estimates
items.summary: Healthcare distributor and services company McKesson (NYSE:MCK) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in calendar Q3 2026 (fiscal Q2 2027), with revenue up 7.6% year on year to $111 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $11.68 per share was 8.6% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
